canonical_project: 昆明万溪冲智算产业园 (Kunming Wanxichong Smart Computing Industrial Park, Chenggong)
owner: Yunnan Digital Economy Development Zone (China Unicom, China Mobile, Huawei, Inspur, Yuntou tenants)
notes: Yunnan's first approved smart-computing industrial cluster (provincial data bureau, Nov 2024); 8 large data centers, 193k sqm built, 21k racks, ~3,034P compute (Sep 2025).
